name: get_order
description: Look up an order by id. Returns customer_id, handled_by (employee_id), status, and a list of line items ({sku, qty}).

name: get_customer
description: Look up a customer by id. Returns name, region, and loyalty_tier.

name: get_product
description: Look up a product by SKU. Returns name, unit_price, and category.

name: get_employee
description: Look up an employee by id. Returns name, role, and manager_id (the employee_id of their manager, or null for the top of the chain).

name: get_shipping_rate
description: Look up the flat shipping rate for a region.

name: get_loyalty_discount
description: Look up the discount percentage (0.0-1.0) for a loyalty tier.
